# 🏥 Diabetes Prediction System

This project predicts whether a patient has diabetes based on medical and lifestyle data.

---

## 📊 Features

- Age
- BMI
- Blood Glucose
- Blood Pressure
- Cholesterol
- Heart Rate
- Physical Activity
- Sleep Hours
- Stress Level
- Family History
- Smoking
- Alcohol

---

## 🤖 Model

- Logistic Regression
- StandardScaler for normalization
- Balanced class handling

---

## 📈 Outputs

- Confusion Matrix
- ROC Curve
- Feature Importance
- Data distribution charts

All outputs saved in `/outputs`

---

## 🚀 Run

```bash
python diabetes_model.py
